messages:
deploy-bot: Rolling canary start: v2026.03.21.2 -> us-west-2 (canary 7%)

nina: quick heads-up: synth probes show elevated 502 errors from the canary az (us-west-2b) starting at 11:06 PT

sahil: any rate-limit spikes or gateway errs? link?

nina: https://dash.internal/redwood/smoke?view=canary-az (short window) 94 502s concentrated on az b, other azs nominal

rohit: grabbing logs from the canary hosts, looks like nginx upstream timed out then returned 502 a few times. backend process OOM?

nina: curl directly to the instance IP returns 200 for health but generate op sometimes 502. sample:
```bash
HTTP/1.1 502 Bad Gateway
Server: nginx
Date: Sun, 21 Mar 2026 18:06:12 GMT
```

ops-bot: @sahil @rohit Alert INC-2026-03-21-09 created: "Canary AZ us-west-2b synth 502 spike". Severity: P2. Paging oncall.

sahil: could be a transient overload from autoscaler warmups. Did the new variant change max-connections or threadpool?

rohit: config diff in release PR shows runtime worker_count increased by 2 and a new memory-tuning flag. maybe pressure on sandboxes.

liz: propose we pause rollout and pin canary traffic back to v2026.03.21.1 in that AZ only, while leaving other regions flowing. we can also increase probe timeout from 1s -> 2s as a temporary measure.

nina: i'm +1 to AZ-scoped pin + probe timeout bump. avoids global rollback and buys time.

sahil: agree. if it's real OOM we should rollback that AZ. but let's test timeout first and watch errors vs latency.

deploy-bot: Action: Pausing rollout to us-west-2b. Pinned us-west-2b canary route -> v2026.03.21.1. Global rollout continues for other AZs. (cmd id: azpin-8812)

rohit: bumped probe timeout to 2s for us-west-2b (cfg id cfg-10012), restarting probe-agent. kicking off synthetic sweep (5 probes per host).

nina: sweep results: 502 rate dropped to 0.7% (was 6.3%). p95 latency modestly up ~30ms. a couple of hosts still show occasional 502.

liz: that's encouraging. let's keep the AZ pin for 45m then resume if stable. also add short release-note: "Mitigation: scoped pin to us-west-2b and increased probe timeout; investigating runtime memory tuning flag"

rohit: creating a follow-up ticket RT-2026-145: "Investigate runtime memory-tuning interaction with worker_count on cold-starts" and assigning to runtime team.

ops-bot: Metric recap: canary 502 before: 0.2%, spike peak: 6.3% (11:06PT), after timeout bump: 0.7% (10m aggregate).

sahil: i'm going to replay the generate workload locally with the new worker_count + mem flag to try and reproduce OOM.

nina: thanks. i'll monitor dashboards and mark incident INC-2026-03-21-09 as mitigated->observing once we hold for 20m.

liz: once we confirm, include decision in release notes: whether to keep mem flag default or gate behind feature flag.

deploy-bot: Rollout state: paused for us-west-2b. To resume AZ pin removal: `deploy-bot unpin azpin-8812` (requires one approver).
